steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Order. Each step waits for the step before it. A step that depends on a later step is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 step depends on a later step

findings.title: Step depends on a later step
findings.fix: Move the step after the one it needs

findings.title: Step with no time
findings.fix: Estimate the time from the last changeover

outcome.notChecked: Actual changeover times on the floor.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] step-3-tooling.md:19  Step with no time.

pros: Checks a step with no time, a step with no owner, and a step that depends on a later step.
cons: Not checked: Actual changeover times on the floor.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-changeover-plan skill on the records for this review.
